Good to know

What can move the price

Drainage

Pits, grates and stormwater connections are priced separately if your driveway needs them.

Slope and levels

A sloped or uneven block needs more forming and levelling to get a proper finish and fall.

Access

Tight side access or no room for the truck can mean pumping or barrowing the pour.

Ground conditions

Soft, rocky or reactive ground can need extra base to hold up over time.
